data.text: I’m in: 15 tons this month, then 15 each at a stock of 100 or 5 each at 50. I’ll stick to those limits even after a bad replenishment draw; the lower catch is what keeps the agreement viable over time. If we encounter a different stock level, let’s agree on revised whole-ton limits before fishing, keeping at least 5 tons in the lake. Emma, you’re the last to confirm—will you join us?
